parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning they share only the structural shape of being zero-field type aliases — not any actual content or domain meaning. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit) each encode a distinct domain event in unrelated subsystems. The structural similarity (`shared_field_count: 1`, `jaccard: null`) is purely coincidental: every empty type alias looks identical to the pipeline. Merging or extracting these would conflate unrelated message types and destroy the semantic clarity that distinct named types provide in a message-passing architecture.
